description: Get a single GitHub developer's ranked profile by username: overall/profile/tech/activity scores, experience, commit activity, top repos, and contact info. Cache-first and fast; use analyze_profile for deep AI analysis.

signals.description: Which derived signals to compute when uncached: 'all' (default), 'timeline', 'timezone', or 'none' for the fastest response.

skills.description: Languages to verify recency/depth for, e.g. ['Scala', 'Go']. Max 10. Adds a skill_checks breakdown (years active, recent/total commits, top repos) per skill to the response.

name: get_developer
title: Get developer profile
